provenance.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
provenance.note: Corpus files are the consolidated Article text with EUR-Lex consolidation markers (▼B, ▼M1), markdown link syntax, non-breaking spaces and soft hyphens removed. See src/lib/rulepack/normalise.ts — the citation verifier applies the same normalisation to both sides before matching.

changelog: Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, OJ 24.7.2026, in force 27.7.2026): Annex III high-risk → 2 Dec 2027; Annex I → 2 Aug 2028; new Art 5(1)(ba) and (bb) prohibitions from 2 Dec 2026; SMC category added (Arts 11, 17, 57, 99(6a)), defined at Art 3(14b) by reference to point (2) of the Annex to Recommendation (EU) 2025/1099. Art 50 transparency in force 2 Aug 2026. Corrected penalty tiers: Art 50 and GPAI sit at €15M/3% (Arts 99(4)(g), 101) — no 1.5% band exists. Added the Art 6(3) profiling override. Retention re-cited to Arts 19(1)/26(6), with Art 12 as the logging capability only. Art 57(1) sandbox deadline extended to 2 Aug 2027 (from 2 Aug 2026) — a separate provision from the 2 Dec 2027 Annex III application date, and not left unchanged.
